segments.sn45.161:1.4: Kāmesanā, bhavesanā, brahmacariyesanā – imā kho, bhikkhave, tisso esanā.
segments.sn45.161:1.6: Imāsaṃ kho, bhikkhave, tissannaṃ esanānaṃ abhiññāya ariyo aṭṭhaṅgiko maggo bhāvetabbo.
segments.sn45.161:1.8: Idha, bhikkhave, bhikkhu sammādiṭṭhiṃ bhāveti vivekanissitaṃ … pe … sammāsamādhiṃ bhāveti vivekanissitaṃ virāganissitaṃ nirodhanissitaṃ vossaggapariṇāmiṃ.
segments.sn45.161:1.9: Imāsaṃ kho, bhikkhave, tissannaṃ esanānaṃ abhiññāya ayaṃ ariyo aṭṭhaṅgiko maggo bhāvetabbo”ti.
segments.sn45.161:2.3: Kāmesanā, bhavesanā, brahmacariyesanā – imā kho, bhikkhave, tisso esanā.
segments.sn45.161:2.5: Imāsaṃ kho, bhikkhave, tissannaṃ esanānaṃ abhiññāya ariyo aṭṭhaṅgiko maggo bhāvetabbo.
segments.sn45.161:2.7: Idha, bhikkhave, bhikkhu sammādiṭṭhiṃ bhāveti … pe … sammāsamādhiṃ bhāveti rāgavinayapariyosānaṃ dosavinayapariyosānaṃ mohavinayapariyosānaṃ.
segments.sn45.161:2.8: Imāsaṃ kho, bhikkhave, tissannaṃ esanānaṃ abhiññāya ayaṃ ariyo aṭṭhaṅgiko maggo bhāvetabbo”ti.
segments.sn45.161:3.3: Kāmesanā, bhavesanā, brahmacariyesanā – imā kho, bhikkhave, tisso esanā.

segments.sn45.161:3.8: Imāsaṃ kho, bhikkhave, tissannaṃ esanānaṃ abhiññāya ayaṃ ariyo aṭṭhaṅgiko maggo bhāvetabbo”ti.
segments.sn45.161:4.3: Kāmesanā, bhavesanā, brahmacariyesanā – imā kho, bhikkhave, tisso esanā.
segments.sn45.161:4.5: Imāsaṃ kho, bhikkhave, tissannaṃ esanānaṃ abhiññāya ariyo aṭṭhaṅgiko maggo bhāvetabbo.
segments.sn45.161:4.7: Idha, bhikkhave, bhikkhu sammādiṭṭhiṃ bhāveti … pe … sammāsamādhiṃ bhāveti nibbānaninnaṃ nibbānapoṇaṃ nibbānapabbhāraṃ.
segments.sn45.161:4.8: Imāsaṃ kho, bhikkhave, tissannaṃ esanānaṃ abhiññāya ayaṃ ariyo aṭṭhaṅgiko maggo bhāvetabbo”ti.
segments.sn45.161:5.3: Kāmesanā, bhavesanā, brahmacariyesanā – imā kho, bhikkhave, tisso esanā.
segments.sn45.161:5.5: Imāsaṃ kho, bhikkhave, tissannaṃ esanānaṃ pariññāya … pe … ayaṃ ariyo aṭṭhaṅgiko maggo bhāvetabbo”ti.(Yadapi abhiññā, tadapi pariññāya vitthāretabbaṃ.)
segments.sn45.161:6.3: Kāmesanā, bhavesanā, brahmacariyesanā – imā kho, bhikkhave, tisso esanā.
segments.sn45.161:6.5: Imāsaṃ kho, bhikkhave, tissannaṃ esanānaṃ parikkhayāya … pe … ayaṃ ariyo aṭṭhaṅgiko maggo bhāvetabbo”ti.(Yadapi abhiññā, tadapi parikkhayāya vitthāretabbaṃ.)
segments.sn45.161:7.3: Kāmesanā, bhavesanā, brahmacariyesanā – imā kho, bhikkhave, tisso esanā.
segments.sn45.161:7.5: Imāsaṃ kho, bhikkhave, tissannaṃ esanānaṃ pahānāya ariyo aṭṭhaṅgiko maggo bhāvetabbo.
segments.sn45.161:7.7: Idha, bhikkhave, bhikkhu sammādiṭṭhiṃ bhāveti … pe … sammāsamādhiṃ bhāveti vivekanissitaṃ virāganissitaṃ nirodhanissitaṃ vossaggapariṇāmiṃ … pe … imāsaṃ kho, bhikkhave, tissannaṃ esanānaṃ pahānāya ayaṃ ariyo aṭṭhaṅgiko maggo bhāvetabbo”ti.(Yadapi abhiññā, tadapi pahānāya vitthāretabbaṃ.) Paṭhamaṃ.

lines: Esanāvagge kāmesanāti kāmānaṃ esanā gavesanā magganā patthanā.
